mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month rolling change < 0), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 4.0% over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 2 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production, S&P 500 returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts indicates strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring a specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises (3-month rolling change > 0), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over 3 months signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls signal severe labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 50k in 1 month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), S&P 500 returns turn negative over the next 5 trading days due to central bank tightening and reduced real equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% yoy, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
